mapper.sql: v.id, v.owner_account_id, v.plate_no, v.vehicle_type_code, v.brand_model, v.vin_last4, v.registered_on, v.use_type, v.verification_status, v.is_default, v.version, a.phone_cipher
mapper.select: SELECT FROM vi_vehicle v JOIN vi_account a ON a.id = v.owner_account_id WHERE v.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY v.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT order_no, fulfillment_status, created_at FROM vi_order WHERE vehicle_id = #{vehicleId} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT r.conclusion, r.inspected_at, r.created_at, o.order_no FROM vi_inspection_result r JOIN vi_order o ON o.id = r.order_id WHERE o.vehicle_id = #{vehicleId} ORDER BY r.id DESC
